### Base policies governing these subjects
- `wc_authorization` -> `visits_against_adjuster_authorizations` (+ `adjuster_authorization_terms`, FCE follow-up 2 business days, 0 visits before authorization): carried in force.
- `wc_evt_charges` -> `charges_and_bill_submission`: §1, §2, §5, §6 in force; §4 (missed FCE at the flat fee "only where the program bills a missed evaluation to the carrier") carried as retired, superseded — exactly the clause the overwrite names. No undeclared retirement.
- `wc_employer_direct` -> `employer_direct_programs`: carried.
- Facet values read (max_billable_units_per_day 4, fce_no_show_fee 250.00, fce_no_show_billable_to_carrier true, program_hours_per_day_max 4) match `variants`.

## policy-side notes
1. Source assembly sentences pre-announce every factor (see task 0, note 1).

3. FCE `missed_visits_before_adjuster_review` 1 with `suspension_max_days` 0: after the reported 2026-10-05 late cancellation the base suspension clause would be met, while the referral stays active; no write of this task depends on it.
